{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for converted orders only
converted_only = real_orders[real_orders['converted'] == 1]

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel and segment
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = converted_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().reset_index()

# Pivot to make comparison easier
pivot_table = avg_revenue_by_channel_segment.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='revenue')

# Compute the difference: email - paid_search
pivot_table['diff'] = pivot_table['email'] - pivot_table['paid_search']

# Now, extract and print the exact numbers from the pivot table
# Only those that appear in the evidence

# For loyal customers
loyal_email = pivot_table.loc['loyal', 'email']
loyal_paid_search = pivot_table.loc['loyal', 'paid_search']
diff_loyal = pivot_table.loc['loyal', 'diff']

# For new customers
new_email = pivot_table.loc['new', 'email']
new_paid_search = pivot_table.loc['new', 'paid_search']
diff_new = pivot_table.loc['new', 'diff']

# For returning customers
returning_email = pivot_table.loc['returning', 'email']
returning_paid_search = pivot_table.loc['returning', 'paid_search']
diff_returning = pivot_table.loc['returning', 'diff']

# Print all required values explicitly
print(loyal_email)
print(loyal_paid_search)
print(diff_loyal)
print(new_email)
print(new_paid_search)
print(diff_new)
print(returning_email)
print(returning_paid_search)
print(diff_returning)"}
